Question: Passage: To eliminate red tape in local business permitting, the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) mandated all local government units (LGUs) to transition to an Electronic Business One-Stop Shop (e-BOSS). - Option D: Cost comparison of paper supplies is irrelevant to registration growth.

Exam Tip: Apply the Negation Test: If negating a statement destroys the author's conclusion
